info.title: IVTEX
info.description:
# CRM-IVTEX API Collection

A comprehensive CRM (Customer Relationship Management) REST API built with Express.js and TypeScript.

## Authentication
Most endpoints require a Bearer token. Use the **Login** request to authenticate and the token will be automatically stored in the `{{token}}` environment variable.

## Roles
- **Admin (A)**: Full access to all endpoints
- **Manager (M)**: Access to most endpoints except user management
- **Executive (E)**: Access to assigned leads, customers, deals, and activities

## Base URL
Set the `BASE_URL` environment variable to your server URL (e.g., `http://localhost:8000`).

## Modules
- **Auth**: Register, login, refresh token, logout, profile management
- **Users**: User management (Admin only)
- **Leads**: Lead lifecycle management with status transitions
- **Customers**: Customer management converted from leads
- **Deals**: Deal pipeline management with stage tracking
- **Activities**: Activity and follow-up tracking across entities
- **Dashboard**: Analytics and reporting
- **Timeline**: Audit history logs
